description:
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Kilo.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put an ice counter on Iceberg.
Resolve the Aura of Dominion ability, untapping Kilo.
Activate Iceberg by removing an ice counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Iceberg
uses.cardState: with an ice counter on it
